en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a formal public garden with manicured flowerbeds, trimmed lawns, and elaborate topiary. In the foreground on the right is a very large urn‑shaped topiary planter overflowing with foliage and a palm; another smaller basket planter stands to the left. A straight paved path cuts through the lawn, with dense mixed plantings and shrubs on both sides. Tall conifer trees form a backdrop, and behind the trees a slender church steeple rises in the distance, partly hidden by foliage. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
